title: Life Plan Residents' Hourly Rate on Re-Rated Personal Services Visits
content:
Residents of the Life Plan campuses who hold an Entrance Fee Agreement are charged a reduced hourly rate when a Personal Services Plan visit charge is re-rated.

## Rule

The re-rated hours beyond those covering the visit are charged at the package's hourly rate beyond the allotment less 4.00 USD where the resident holds an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement on a lifecare contract (the LifeCare Declining Balance Plan or the LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan), at the package's hourly rate beyond the allotment less 2.00 USD where the resident holds an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement on a fee-for-service contract (any LifeChoice plan), and at the package's hourly rate beyond the allotment otherwise, the re-rated charge being rounded to the cent half up.

The test reads the resident's Entrance Fee Agreement records: whether an agreement is recorded as occupied, and the contract type of that agreement — lifecare for the LifeCare Declining Balance Plan and the LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan, fee-for-service for any LifeChoice plan.

## Rates by tier (USD per hour)

| Tier | Occupied Entrance Fee Agreement, lifecare contract | Occupied Entrance Fee Agreement, fee-for-service contract | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 45.00 | 47.00 | 49.00 |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 42.50 | 44.50 | 46.50 |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 40.00 | 42.00 | 44.00 |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 38.00 | 40.00 | 42.00 |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 36.00 | 38.00 | 40.00 |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 34.00 | 36.00 | 38.00 |

## Points of judgement

- An Entrance Fee Agreement that is not recorded as occupied does not change the rate.
- A resident with no Entrance Fee Agreement is charged the package's rate.
- *Hypothetical:* 0.75 re-rated hour on the Companion Package for a resident with an occupied lifecare agreement is 0.75 multiplied by 40.00, or 30.00 USD; with a fee-for-service agreement, 0.75 multiplied by 42.00, or 31.50 USD; otherwise 0.75 multiplied by 44.00, or 33.00 USD.
